cells.tense: The vision is arriving on time, shaped by what has already been lived.
cells.act: go where the feeling is already pulling
cells.ask: Follow where the feeling already leans and take one step into it, with no plan stretching ahead.
cells.core:
What you picture now comes after the living, not instead of it. Something has been digested — a stretch of life, a hard passage — and the images that rise out of it land on real ground. You can stand back from the whole shape and still act inside it, which is the thing you were asking for without words.

The pull is the signal worth following. Go where the feeling already leans and take one small move. You do not have to see the whole road or explain why that direction matters. The integration is what makes this safe; the feeling is what makes it yours. Feed it one step at a time.
cells.sheetLine: Your images are arriving on time now.
cells.place: Outside the system, still inside it — seeing across all the layers

cells.tense: The picture is being treated as the ground, and the ground is not being touched.
cells.act: tend it small and ask nothing of it
cells.ask: Pick one struggling thing close at hand and tend just it, leaving the meaning of it alone.
cells.core:
The dream has stopped being a map and started being the town. You see the pattern so fully that the pattern is doing the living, and the ordinary parts — one person's actual mood, a deadline, a body that needs food — keep losing to the symbolic version. From inside this it feels like depth; from the outside it looks like nothing gets tended.

What is growing here needs less interpretation, not more. Choose one small, real thing and give it what it actually needs today — the plain kind of care, no forcing, no verdict on what it means. Let the pattern be the backdrop, not the daily work. One tended thing will bring the ground back under the vision.
cells.sheetLine: You're living in the picture instead of standing on the ground.
cells.place: Outside the system, still inside it — seeing across all the layers

cells.tense: The road was left at a door that has already closed behind you.
cells.act: let a perception land without arguing it
cells.ask: Whether an impression about an open situation can stand this time, and let the first explanation wait.
cells.core:
At some point the step you could not fully explain stopped being trusted. What remains is the measurable part of things, and whatever has no account attached gets filed as noise. The world is accurate at this level and not alive at it, and the missing half is starting to show in how flat the days read.

A perception does not need to be argued to be worth having. When one unproven impression about the open situation arrives, try letting it stand while the first explanation waits. You are not being asked to believe it. You are only letting it stay long enough to be felt before reason takes the wheel.
cells.sheetLine: You stopped trusting the step you couldn't argue for.

cells.tense: The life is being steered by a story nobody is claiming to be writing.
cells.act: keep the steady light lit by attention, not flash
cells.ask: Tend the plain practice again today, alone, without turning it into a plan or a verdict.
cells.core:
The dreaming is real and whoever holds the pen is not signing. There is a version of the future running your choices — what you avoid, what you invest in, where you keep ending up — and you would say you had not noticed the pattern. It shows in the shape of your days before it shows in your account of them, because you are inside it while the pattern is doing the steering.

What returns you is unglamorous and repetitive. Keep the plain practice lit, alone, before you build plans around it. Solitude here connects; it is not the isolation of leaving the world, just the quiet where your own blend of attention gets trained. Repeat it enough and the picture you have been steered by becomes a picture you hold.
cells.sheetLine: You're led by a dream you haven't claimed.
cells.place: Outside the system, still inside it — seeing across all the layers

attempts.check: The draft wants to treat the person's ambiguity as a subject they are navigating deliberately ('you dream because you have processed it'), which the record supports only as the Balanced face, not as their history. A reader could reasonably say the Too Much cell assigns motive to their symbols ('you are seeking') rather than describing the mechanism. The asks survive being wrong because each asks for one visible act — moving a step, tending a small thing, waiting on one perception, doing the practice again — that teaches something about attention even if the read is off. The sentence that serves the writer more than the person is any line that congratulates their depth; cut those.
